kjv: Where [there is] no vision, the people perish
mine: Where there is no prophetic vision the people cast off restraint
note: Hebrew chazon is prophetic revelation (cf. 1 Sam 3:1) and yippara' means "let loose, run wild" (Exod 32:25), not "perish"; the verse is widely quoted about leadership vision, which is not its sense.

kjv: shall have him become [his] son at the length
mine: will in the end find him his heir
note: Hebrew manon is a hapax of uncertain meaning (guesses: "son, heir", "grief", "insolent"); both renderings are conjectures.
